versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_ext: 
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - .docm
        - .dotm
        - .xlsm
        - .xltm
        - .potm 
        - .pptm
        - .pptx 
selection_cmd:
    - Image|endswith:
        - \cmd.exe
        - \powershell.exe
    - ParentImage|endswith:
        - \cmd.exe
        - \powershell.exe
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: TargetFilename IN ("*.docm", "*.dotm", "*.xlsm", "*.xltm", "*.potm", "*.pptm", "*.pptx") Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") OR ParentImage IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe")
